comments.note: Test method names differ from AC spec names (e.g. 'SearchText_SingleTerm_FiltersToMatchingMovies' vs 'SearchText_SingleTerm_NarrowsMoviesByLabel'). The implementation split each AC behavior into multiple narrowly-scoped test methods which is superior to single-method coverage. All behaviors are fully covered.

Tests were placed in a new dedicated file 'MoviesListViewModelSearchFilterTests.cs' rather than extending 'MoviesListViewModelTests.cs' as the scope stated. This is a better design choice (separation of concerns) and has no negative impact.

FakeFilterManagerService.cs is listed in the WP-014 scope but was not created. No test in the suite currently references it. This will be needed when WP-012 (open manager integration) adds tests that depend on IFilterManagerService. Flag for the Developer to create before WP-012 tests.
FiltersManagerViewModelTests has 16 passing tests vs. 9 planned. The additional tests (SelectedSlot_Changed, ConfirmDelete guard, DeleteSlotCommand CanExecute variants) improve coverage. All 16 pass.

summary: Code review PASS. Both MoviesListViewModelSearchFilterTests and FiltersManagerViewModelTests are clean, well-isolated, and behaviorally comprehensive. Both new fakes (FakeFilterSlotRepository, FakeActiveFilterSlotRepository) follow the established fake pattern correctly. One pre-WP-012 gap: FakeFilterManagerService.cs is absent and FakeFilterSlotRepository.DeleteAsync does not remove from internal state (harmless now but will mislead future tests).

comments.note: FakeFilterSlotRepository.DeleteAsync does not update the internal _slots list after deletion. For current tests this is not an issue because FiltersManagerViewModel manages its Slots ObservableCollection directly (removes by SlotId without re-fetching). However, future tests that verify collection state post-delete via GetAllAsync would get stale data from the fake. Worth fixing before WP-012 tests are written.
FakeFilterManagerService.cs is missing (noted by QA as a scope gap). No current test references it. Must be created before WP-012 adds integration tests that inject IFilterManagerService.

Both fakes (FakeFilterSlotRepository, FakeActiveFilterSlotRepository) are well-structured with explicit call-count tracking and last-argument capture — good pattern for behaviorally asserting repository interactions without mocking libraries.

Test classes are correctly sealed, use fresh fakes per test (no shared state), and each test asserts exactly one behavior. Naming follows [Subject]_[Condition]_[ExpectedResult] convention consistently.

[documentation-forward] api-surface.md should document FakeFilterSlotRepository and FakeActiveFilterSlotRepository as test helpers (file-tree.md should list them under tests/VideoIndexer.App.Tests/TestHelpers/). Also note that FakeFilterManagerService.cs is a planned addition pre-WP-012.

notes: All 12 ACs verified. 496 tests pass (0 failed). SearchFilter tests (19), FiltersManagerViewModelTests (16), MoviesListViewModelTests (9) all green. Minor note: FakeFilterManagerService.cs is absent (scope gap, not a blocker); flag for pre-WP-012 creation. Ready for code review.

WP-014 PASS. All 12 ACs met. Test suite is well-organized and properly isolated.
